label: Updated at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Justin Thomas Withdraws
items.text: Justin Thomas abruptly withdrew from the inaugural Biltmore Championship in Asheville a week before the Presidents Cup, giving no reason for his withdrawal.

items.headline: Brendan Valdes Returns
items.text: Brendan Valdes returns to Tour-sanctioned golf at the Biltmore Championship after beating primary mediastinal lymphoma and being cancer-free since June.
